name: Albania

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 2363314 inhabitants, recorded as 2.363 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Searched on 2026-07-27, in Albanian, in the transversal venues pass. One, and it is the country's national puppet theatre in Tirana, in a building of 1924 that was the Officers' House and then Albania's first parliament before becoming the puppet theatre in the 1960s. Read on the EU delegation's announcement of its reopening: the house was badly damaged by the earthquake of November 2019, restored under the EU4Culture programme with UNOPS implementing, and reopened with a capacity of about 130. What makes it public is in the same page — the restoration was run in partnership with Albania's Ministry of Economy, Culture and Innovation, and the theatre is the national one. The value was already 1 as an opening estimate; it is the same number with a source under it and a point on the map. Recorded open rather than verified because the governing body was not read at first hand: the site of the Qendra Kombëtare e Kulturës për Fëmijë, which now carries the theatre, answered 403. The coordinate is geocoded through Nominatim, which returns the building under its own name, Teatri i Kukullave. No second Albanian puppet venue was looked for, and the Pogradec puppetry festival suggests the country's puppetry is not confined to Tirana.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The University of Arts in Tirana, the country's only public higher arts institution, offers within its Faculty of Scenic Art only the programmes Acting, Directing, Scenography and Choreography. No puppetry stream. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1, the detailed acting curriculum not having been read. Estimate.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90.
